summary: Iter 93 GODMODE launch-check — 9/9 backend tests PASS. Auth persistence (30d cookie Max-Age=2592000, refresh EXTENDS same session token instead of creating new, 3 concurrent devices all stay valid), magic-link generic 200, Google provider config with client_id starting 482961656741, voice conversation graceful TTS degrade (200 with response_text=77 chars, audio_url='' — no 502), video-challenges list 200, chat multi-turn same session_id, VANTA security headers all present (CSP + HSTS max-age=63072000 preload + COOP same-origin-allow-popups + X-Frame-Options). Frontend login page renders correctly with Google button visible.

minor.issue: Admin test account test@test.com (is_admin=true, tier=plus) is treated as FREE user by routes/credits.py — only premium=true bypasses the 50-credit limit. The 50 credits had been consumed on this account (52 entries in history) so ALL chat/voice/video-mission calls returned 402 no_credits until I manually topped balance to 500 in Mongo to complete the review-request tests. This should be considered before launch: either (a) map tier in {standard,accelerator,plus,leadership_os,...} → unlimited, (b) auto-refill on rollover, or (c) treat is_admin=true as unlimited. Without this, admins & paying-tier users hit soft-402 in production too.

action_items: CONSIDER: Extend check_and_deduct_credit() in routes/credits.py to also bypass credits when user.tier in a paid-tiers set OR user.is_admin — currently only user.premium=True bypasses, so paid `plus`-tier admins hit 402 no_credits after 50 free calls.
NO CODE CHANGES REQUIRED for the actual review scope (session persistence + graceful TTS degrade + all other launch-check items) — all verified working end-to-end.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/auth.py L482-502 (/api/auth/refresh): implementation correctly finds existing session_token from cookie and extends its expires_at instead of _create_session() — no duplicate row, no eviction of other-device sessions. Verified by asserting new_token == orig_token after refresh.

services.py L63-80 (_authenticate_via_session): sliding renewal (extends when <15d left) fires as asyncio.ensure_future — good non-blocking pattern; MongoDB update happens fire-and-forget without blocking the auth response.

routes/voice_tts.py step-6 graceful TTS: verified end-to-end. When ElevenLabs returns 401/quota-exhausted, endpoint returns 200 with audio_url='' + full response_text — never 502. Frontend useVoiceMode.js.playReply handles empty audio_url and restarts listen loop.

routes/credits.py L26-63: check_and_deduct_credit only special-cases user.premium=True. is_admin and paid-tiers (tier=plus, tier=standard, tier=accelerator, tier=leadership_os) are NOT treated as unlimited. This is the underlying reason the admin test-account hit 402 no_credits mid-testing. Suggest adding: `if user.get('premium') or user.get('is_admin') or user.get('tier') in {'standard','accelerator','plus','leadership_os','leadership_os_2x','leadership_os_12x','leadership_os_plus'}: return {'allowed': True, 'remaining': -1, 'is_premium': True}`.
